class Pupil:
    def __init__(self, aNumber, aMentor):
        self._number = aNumber
        self._mentor = None
        if not self.setMentor(aMentor):
            raise RuntimeError("Unable to create pupil due to mentor. See https://manual.umple.org?RE002ViolationofAssociationMultiplicity.html")

    def setNumber(self, aNumber):
        self._number = aNumber
        return True

    def getNumber(self):
        return self._number

    def getMentor(self):
        return self._mentor

    def setMentor(self, aMentor):
        if aMentor is None:
            return False
        if aMentor.numberOfPupils() >= aMentor.maximumNumberOfPupils():
            return False
        existingMentor = self._mentor
        self._mentor = aMentor
        if existingMentor is not None and existingMentor is not aMentor:
            if not existingMentor.removePupil(self):
                self._mentor = existingMentor
                return False
        self._mentor.addPupil(self)
        return True

    def delete(self):
        placeholderMentor = self._mentor
        self._mentor = None
        if placeholderMentor is not None:
            placeholderMentor.removePupil(self)

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "number:" + str(self.getNumber())
                + "]"
                + "\n  mentor = " + ("null" if self.getMentor() is None else format(id(self.getMentor()), "x")))
